4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of Sr.DFM/BPL payable at Sr.DFM/BPL . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Sr.DFM/BPL A/C (Name of the Seller). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name Sr.DFM/BPL Account No. 36903558215 IFSC Code SBIN0000390

Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK (In addition to Gem Service level agreement which will be applicable to this tender) 1. HIRING OF ONE NUMBER PASSENGER FOUR-WHEELER VEHICLE WITH DRIVERS FOR OFFICIAL AND FIELD USE FOR ADSTE/ET TO RUN ON ENTIRE BPL DIVISION FOR A PE RIOD OF 36 MONTHS. ESTIMATED MONTHLY RUNNING 2000 KMS PER MONTH DURI NG 36 MONTHS. (Base station as mentioned can also be changed as per convenience of administration during the contract period). Charges for monthly running to be calculated for 06 months basis, this means if any vehicle runs less than 2000 kms in any month then balance kilometers will be c arry forward up to 06 months. Monthly base package is inclusive of night charges. 2. DEFINITION OF SIMILAR WORK –ANY WORK OF HIRING OF PASSENGER VEHICLE, UTI LITY VEHICLE SUCH AS PICK-UP VAN, TRUCK, LORRIES, ETC. FOR ANY CENTRAL / ST ATE GOVT ORGANIZATION / PSU / PUBLIC LISTED COMPANY. 3. The vehicle is required to run as per the instructions of ADSTE/ET.

4. The successful bidder is requested to submit Performance Guaran tee equivalent to 5 % of the contract value within 30 days from th e date of issue of Gem contract, valid up to stipulated date of com pletion plus 60 days, so that contract agreement can be executed. The successful bidder shall have to submit a Performance Guarantee (PG) valuing 5% of the contract value within 30 (thirty) days from the date of is sue of Gem contract, Extension of time for submission of PG beyond 30 (th irty) days and up to the date of submission of PG from the date of issue of Gem contract may be given by the Authority who is competent to sign the contract agreement. However, a penal interest of 15% per annum shall be charged for the delay beyond 30 (thirty days, i.e. from 31st day after the d ate of issue of Gem contract. In case the contractor fails to submit the req uisite PG after 60 days from the date of issue of Gem contract, a notice sh all be served to the contractor to deposit the PG immediately however not exceeding 90 days from the date of issue of Gem contract). In case the c ontractor fails to submit the requisite PG even after 90 days from the date of issue of Gem contract, the contract shall be terminate d duly forfeiting EMD and other dues, if any payable against that contract. The failed contractor shall be debarred from participating in re-t ender for that work. In case 60th day is a bank holiday or office closure ne xt working day should be considered as the last day for submission of the PG’s. Decision of Authority competent to sign the Contract Agreement wou ld be final in case of any dispute. The value of PG to be submitted by the c ontractor will not change for variation up to 25% (either increase or decre ase). In case during the course of execution, value of the contract increase s by more than 25% of the original contract value, an additional Performan ce Guarantee amounting to 10% (ten percent) for the excess value over th e original contract value shall be deposited by the contractor. On the other hand, if the value of Contract decreases by more than 25% of the original contract value, Performance guarantee amounting to 10% of the decrease in the contract value shall be returned to contractor. The PG amount in ex cess of required PG for decreased contract value, available with railways s hall be returned to the contractor duly safeguarding the interest of Railways. The applicable Performance Guarantee shall be calculated as pe r the revised value of the contract covering all variations up to the determi nation of the contract. The PG shall be encashed after the completion of th e contract. (This clause shall be binding on the successful bidder as per Indian Railway GCC for services 2018) 5. The vehicle is to be run between various stations over Bhopal Division mainly. In case of requ irement, it may be used over other divisional jurisdiction as per the instruction of the ADSTE/ ET. The station where this vehicle is required to be kept for supervision will be at the discreti on of administration. Further the starting station (Base station as mentioned in Para 1 above) can also be changed as per convenience of administration. 6. Vehicle may also be required to keep over night at any station as per the field requirements. For such overnight stays, all arrangements of driver and vehicle have to be done by contract or at his own cost. 7. Vehicle will be made available by the contractor for all days of the week. As per requirement, vehicle may be asked anytime. Weekly rest will be given as per convenience of railway. Duri ng the rest period of driver, an alternate driver should be arranged by the contractor.

8. Vehicles will have to be made available within 7 days of date of commencement mentioned i n the Gem contract. 9. The tenderer has to arrange vehicle and its accessories as per the requirement of running of vehicle and keep the vehicle in good condition 10. The complete maintenance of the vehicle will be the responsibility of the tenderer. 11. The vehicle will be permitted to be withdrawn for servicing and maintenance etc. only after al ternative vehicle is provided. As far as possible same type of vehicle shall be arranged as me ntioned in the schedule. However, in case of acceptance of officer in charge of vehicle equiva lent type of vehicle may be accepted. 12. Logbook will be maintained for vehicle. 13. Railway administration shall not be responsible for any accident, damage etc. to the vehicle during the period of hire. 14. The place of keeping the vehicle and the controlling officer/consignee may be changed at the discretion of administration. 15. Vehicle should be in self-starting, good working condition to run on Kachcha Road also. 16. In case the vehicle gets out of order, an alternative vehicle must be arranged within are as o n able time as per GEM service level agreement. 17. The interiors, and exteriors, and furnishings of the vehicles should be excellent. 18. Driver shall be punctual, well behaved, and decent. He shall obey all lawful instructions of the officer in charge of the vehicle. If driver fails to do so the contractor shall replace the driver i mmediately. 19. Petrol, diesel, Mobil Oil etc. for the use in vehicle along with the Driver from the time of hiring shall be provided by contractor of vehicle at his own cost including the wages of staff. 20. Counting of Kms. for payment purposes will start from BASE STATION OF VEHICLE. 21. The tenderer shall have comprehensive insurance for the vehicle throughout of the operating period. The tenderer have to submit the insurance papers. In case any default all responsibility will be of the tenderer. The contractors will produce for perusal of the Railway t he original insurance policy and proof of payment of all insurance premium charges in respec t thereof as and when demanded by Railway. 22. The contractor/Firm should have/arrange necessary permit for the states under the jurisdictio n of Bhopal Division. 23. Payment will be paid Quarterly (except final month) of schedule items. Payment shall be don e after deducting any penalty charges for lapse on the part of the firm as given above.

24. Payment of on account bill for the Tendered work will be arranged by the Sr. Divisional Signal & Telecom Engineer/Co/BPL in charge of the work through the associate Accounts Officer. Pay ments shall be made Quarterly. At the end of every month, the contractor may submit his bill after recording of joint measurement in quadruplicate within 10 days on the each month to t he nominated representative of the Railway administration. The nominated representative sh all verify and forward the bills to Sr.DSTE/Co/BPL for arranging payment. 25. Penalty whichever is applicable shall be deducted from the on-account bills. 26. All the penalty and conditions will be as per service level agreement of GeM of this work. 27. The Fast-tag card/Toll charges shall be borne by contractor (if any) irrespective of number of visits on same route or alternate route. The sole responsibility of Fast-tag charges/Toll charge s shall be of the contractor at his own cost. 28. 1. S​ite consignee for the subjected work will be SSE/SIG/ET. 2. Test check officer will be ADSTE/ET 3. However Sr. DSTE/Co/BPL may change consignees and reporting officer at later stage. 4. Place of reporting for Vehicle Driver will be Office of ADSTE/ET or at the residence of the off icer concerned. Vehicle driver shall not leave their reporting place without informing Site Con signees. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA File Attachment Click here to view the file.
